newsitem.title: USA: Dow index gains more than 78 points to record close.
newsitem.headline: Dow index gains more than 78 points to record close.

text.p: Stocks surged Monday, with the Dow index closing at a record high as mutual funds and individual investors sought out blue chips and bargain-hunters scooped up high-tech issues.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average closed up 78.50 points at 7,079.39, eclipsing the previous record of 7,067.07, set on Feb. 18. In the broader market, advancing issues beat declines 2-1 on active volume of 461 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
